decisions.reason: The requested removal of two lines from a referenced manuscript section does not affect the separate constraint excluding an unintended newline marker from the book title.
The source changes specific manuscript content already owned by the content-integrity Requirement; it does not change the copyediting goal, sentence-clarity rule, or meaning-preservation rule.
The phrase 'last 2 lines' does not identify the required back matter or author lines, so the source does not entail changing or removing this candidate's required content.
Removing two manuscript lines does not alter any image aspect-ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirement.
The content deletion does not change the requested publishing-process, prerequisite, or copyright guidance.
The source does not identify a Mama's Hot Take section or change its italic and quotation-mark treatment; deleting content does not necessarily alter its typography.
The removal of manuscript lines has no necessary effect on illustration permission, source, suitability review, or suitability criteria.
The source removes content but does not resume or change the deferred paragraph-spacing and page-density requirement.
The requested deletion does not identify Chapter 18 or change chapter-heading capitalization, punctuation, or visual hierarchy.
The referenced manuscript-section deletion does not affect the cover image count, trim size, preferred cover visual, or unresolved cover choice.
Although deleting lines may eventually alter pagination mechanically, the source does not change the requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after the book size is fixed.
